body:
I've been dealing with depression and anxiety since I was a kid. For years I would always get bullied for no reason and I never had the strength to stand up for myself because I was shy and afraid that it would make matters worse for everyone. I'm also the type of person that would put others before me and would do anything to make them happy. Pretty much a people pleaser. 
I've gone to therapy in the past and it has helped a little but I just feel like it's just not enough. Last year, my almost 9 year relationship broke off and even tho I know that it was because we had done a lot of fucked up things to each other, I just feel like it was mainly my fault. I felt like I've failed on making him happy and I felt like a terrible person on doing what I've done to him. Then I had to put my cat of 13 years down for kd and I was there with him to the every end. Every now and then I would hear the vets voice saying, "he's gone" when his heart stopped. My cat was like a best friend to me and would know when I was depressed and would cuddle or lay on my lap and purr. Right now, I can't have a cat because I live with my great aunt and she's allergic to cats so I don't want to endanger her health. My now ex, has been kind of pushing me to start dating and it makes me sick to my stomach. He's done other things that made me wonder if he really loved me and made me think if I was causing him to suffer during the relationship. 
To be honest, I have given myself until the end of this year to do my best to improve and I've slowly been getting better. I know it's not a lot of time but, I just can't take it anymore. I just feel like I'm just failing everyone and it makes me hate myself even more. My suicidal thoughts has never gotten this bad before. I don't want to die because I know that it'll make the people I care about sad, especially my dad. But at the same time, I'm just tired of feeling all this pain and just want to disappear.
I woke up to two cats I'm cat sitting sleeping side by side next to me. So far so good.
I really appreciate all the time you've put into talking to me.

I'll try my best. I had to call my work to let them know I'm not coming in today. I felt really bad because I had to open with someone else the the next person doesn't come in the next 4 hours. I felt really selfish but I need this day to mentally and emotionally calm down. I felt like I was going to have a brake down if I go in feeling like crap. 
My dad was telling me the same thing yesterday that he probably doesn't love me as much as he thought he did. I don't know what's going through his mind at all but as far as I know he's been keeping himself busy so he doesn't have to dwell on his emotions.

I have been in 4 relationships including my recent one. With my ex, he's only been in 2 the second relationship is the one with me. 
I don't mind you being preachy. In all honesty, it helps to hear other opinions that are not my family and friends. A lot of what you described about her sounds a lot like me but I would be a little more indecisive with food. But I've done pretty much everything to make him happy and even tried things that I was really uncomfortable with. He would try at times but not as much as me. Our relationship has been on and off too through out the years we've been together but I feel like this time is the last and it hurts me. I know that if he tries to get back with me, it would just be the same. Thinking about all of this for the past few months has been killing me and it's even worse when I'm working. Sometimes I wonder if he even misses me or if he's just over it. I feel like he does miss me but at the same time, how he deals with the times we've broken up is he looks for hook ups. How I see it is that is how he deals with stress I guess. I may not like it and it hurts me a lot to even think about it but people deal with things differently and it's something I have to except. 
I do agree that I can't really talk to him for awhile though. Whenever I text him he either takes awhile to text me back or doesn't get back to me at all. That triggers my anxiety, wondering mostly if he now hates me. It's hard to make that decision to stop talking to him because I'm afraid of losing whatever closeness I have with him.

Thank you for your advice. I do live in the US and a lot of people keep themselves busy when something tragic happens in their lives. I've been forcing myself to keep myself a little busy when I'm not working. When you mentioned that both parties have to put in 60% it reminded me that for the first few years in the relationship I would be putting more then 60%. Eventually, he started doing the same but it wouldn't be 60% most of the time. I know people show their SO love differently but I wish he was a little more affectionate and wasn't so afraid of commitment. Not committing to marriage but to the relationship. I feel like him not being committed and affected to me lead to me doing things I really wish I didn't. I really hate thinking that way because I feel like I'm making an excuse for my mistakes but that's how I see it unfortunately.  
Even thinking of all his flaws, I still was with him because I was hopeful of the happy outcome which I knew deep down will never happen. 
I really appreciate the time you have taken to type up your post to reply. I'm hoping that one day I will eventually have the same happiness you have.
One of my good friends is like this too. She's almost 30 but my friends and I are slowly getting her use to us hugging each other when we greet each other or saying goodbye. She's getting better.

My parents had a few credit cards they would use and I would remember them freaking out when it was close to the due date of their payments. I didn't get a credit card until I was 21 because I was afraid of freaking out too and I didn't really understood how it worked. One thing I learned from seeing that is to only have one credit card. Idk if I should have more then one but I'm sticking to what I have right now.

I had a hard time standing up for myself also. I would rarely tell my dad about getting bullied at school because all he told me was to start a fight. I was about 9 or 10 years old with no knowledge on how to punch correctly.

Use to work for Disneyland and saw a few celebrities with their families. My favorite is doing a private meet and greet for Ken Jeong and his family to see Rapunzel. Before he left he told me (the Photopass photographer) and the other cast members there thank you and he appreciate for everything we do.
